name: viverse-pls-starter-world
description: Adopt assets from a Polygon Streaming starter-world repository (Medieval Starter 100 in dkatz23/PolygonStreamingWorlds) into an existing Three.js game: reach the private repo, read the catalog and saved-scene formats, fix stream URLs, mount and fit streamed buildings per level, keep them out of gameplay lanes, gate stage start on model-load, and verify headlessly.
prerequisites: Existing Three.js game that already runs one shared Polygon Streaming StreamController (see viverse-polygon-streaming-threejs)
GitHub access to the starter-world repository (collaborator invitation accepted, gh auth login done)
Node.js 20+ and Playwright (headless Chromium) for verification
